overview.title: Course overview
overview.noNumbers: There is nothing to count yet — once the course is running and students join, the numbers appear here.

pending.body: This course is still being reviewed. Until it is approved its categories, problems, members and data endpoints all read as missing, so this page stays empty.

myCourse.title: My course
myCourse.thisWeekEmpty: Your teacher has not published this week yet. It will appear here once they do.
myCourse.progress: What I am doing in this course
myCourse.noWork: There is nothing for you to do yet. Assignments appear here once your teacher publishes them.
myCourse.nothingToHandIn: Nothing to hand in this week

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.body: This screen collects work and reviews it: the teacher sees submissions waiting, the student sees what is due this week. The assignments task fills it in.

people.title: Students & groups
people.body: This screen is the roster and the groups: who is in the course and who works with whom. Teams already exist; the students-and-groups task fills in the screen.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.body: This screen is a quiz: students answer it from the week it belongs to, objective questions are graded automatically, and written answers land in the teacher's review queue. The quiz task builds the mechanism.

team.title: My group
team.body: This screen is my group: who I work with and how far the group has got. The teams task fills it in.

units.title: Teaching units
units.empty: No units yet. A course is a sequence of weeks: add one, say what it teaches and whether anything is due, and publish it when that week arrives.
units.noAssignment: Nothing to hand in this week
units.loadFailed: Could not read this course's units.
units.saveFailed: That did not save. Try again.

form.title: What this week teaches
form.titleHint: One line — this is what students see.
form.summaryHint: Optional. The points of the week, or something to remind students of.
form.assignment: What is handed in this week
form.assignmentHint: Pick a problem of this board; a lecture-only week picks none.
form.publishNowHint: Unchecked it stays a draft until that week arrives — students cannot see an unpublished unit.
form.required: A week number and a title are both needed.

create.name: Problem board name
create.ownership: A platform administrator will review your application. Once approved, you can publish and review problems in your problem board.
create.visibility: The problem board will appear in the explore list after approval.
create.failed: Could not create the problem board. Please try again.
create.courseTemplate: What you get is a course space: the course template is applied by default, so there is nothing to pick. You become this board's teacher and creator.

review.title: Board requests
review.emptyMine: You have not applied for a problem board yet.
review.loadFailed: Could not load applications. Please try again.
review.adminHelp: Approval makes the problem board public and lets its owner publish problems. Include a reason when rejecting an application.
review.actionFailed: Review could not be completed. Refresh to check the application status before retrying.

detail.creator: Created by {creator}
detail.noPermission: You don't have permission to publish announcements

auditTasks.title: Problems awaiting review
auditTasks.resubmittable: Can be submitted more than once

manageCategories.title: Manage categories
manageCategories.confirmArchive: Archive this category? Problems in it keep their link to it.
manageCategories.name: Name
manageCategories.categoryNameMaxLength: Category name can be at most 32 characters
manageCategories.descriptionMaxLength: Description can be at most 255 characters

discussions.title: Discussions
discussions.deleteConfirm: Delete this discussion? All of its replies will be deleted too.
discussions.discussionNotFound: This discussion doesn't exist or has been deleted
discussions.startDiscussion: No discussions yet — start the first one!
discussions.noRepliesYet: No replies yet — be the first to reply!

inviteCodes.title: Invite codes
inviteCodes.help: Send a code to whoever you want to invite. They enter it on the "My work" page and join this board. Codes are shared — don't post them in public.
inviteCodes.maxUsesHint: How many people may join with this code
inviteCodes.maxUsesInvalid: Enter a whole number greater than 0
inviteCodes.expiresOnHint: Leave empty for a code that never expires
inviteCodes.createFailed: Could not create the invite code
inviteCodes.createdBody: Send it to whoever you want to invite. They enter it on the "My work" page and join this board.
